tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a free, no-signup group-scheduling event (like When2meet) and get a shareable link. Give it candidate dates and a daily time window; it builds the availability grid. tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Read the current state of a meetwhen event: how many people responded, who, and the best overlapping time(s) so far. Use the event id returned by create_event (or found in a meetwhen /e/<id> URL).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_event, get_event · Public sink: create_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_event, get_event · Public sink: create_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
